english.title: Water undertaker fail enter name and address on register of person entitled under section 197
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker, without reasonable excuse, failed to enter the name and address of a person in the register of persons and premises kept for the purposes of section 166 of the Water Industry Act 1991 in respect of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which abutted a watercourse, namely **(..SPECIFY WATERCOURSE..), that person having requested to be so registered, being

(A)_[the owner or occupier of]_
(B)_[an officer of an association of owners and occupiers of premises which abutted on that watercourse and included]_

those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 197(2) and (3) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
